blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Earth embeddings are compressed representations of rich Earth observation data that enable downstream models to tackle a wide range of complex geospatial tasks. Yet, this increase in performance comes at the cost of decreased interpretability, as the semantic meaning of Earth embeddings is unknown. To address this challenge, we borrow methods from the field of computational neuroscience, which aim to interpret activity in (biological) neurons. Here, we adapt and apply these methods to assign meaning to AlphaEarth embeddings. We analyse embedding features both as stand-alone data, equivalent to spontaneous neural activity, and in relation to land cover and elevation correlates, equivalent to stimulus-response neural activity. We demonstrate correlational and multi-scale structure in the embedding features. Embedding features can display highly specific and directional tuning to land cover and elevation, such as a `North vs South woodland edge' response. When we remove the main trends of combined land cover responses (like water versus land tuning), we discover fine-grained representational details with increased effective dimensionality. Together, our analyses start to unravel what these Earth embeddings represent, which is critical for developing trustworthy downstream applications.
blocks.zh: 地嵌入是丰富的地球观测数据的压缩表示,使下游模型能够完成广泛的复杂的地理空间任务. 然而,这种性能的提高是以可解释性下降为代价的,因为地球嵌入的语义含义是未知的. 为了应对这一挑战,我们借用了计算神经科学领域的方法,这些方法旨在解释(生物)神经元中的活动。 在这里,我们适应并应用这些方法来给AlphaEarth嵌入物分配意义. 我们分析嵌入特征,既作为独立数据,相当于自发神经活动,又与土地覆盖和高地相关,相当于刺激-反应神经活动。 我们在嵌入式特征中展示了相关和多尺度的结构。 嵌入特征可以表现出高度具体和方向性地调整到土地覆盖和高地,例如“北对南林地边缘”反应。 当我们去除土地覆被综合反应的主要趋势(如水与地调)时,我们发现精细的描述性细节,增加了有效的维度. 我们的分析一起开始解析这些嵌入地球的事物,这对开发可信赖的下游应用至关重要。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Geospatial foundation models are self-supervised models that construct Earth embeddings and aim to capture rich, multi-modal Earth observation data in compressed embedding features ( Tseng et al., 2023 ; Brown et al., 2025 ; Klemmer et al., 2025 ) . These embeddings introduce a paradigm shift for downstream geospatial tasks, presenting easily accessible, compressed representations of diverse Earth observation data on which a (simple) classifier or regression model can be trained. However, contrary to the raw Earth observation data with which they are trained, the semantic meaning of embedding representations is unknown a priori .
In other words, we are presented with a vast source of data, which we know should contain rich information, yet hidden to the observer.
blocks.zh:
地理空间地基模型是自行监督的模型,用于构建地基嵌入并旨在以压缩地基特征获取丰富多式地球观测数据(Tseng等,2023;Brown等,2025;Klemmer等,2025)。 这些嵌入物为下游地理空间任务引入了范式转变,提出了各种地球观测数据的易于取用和压缩的表述,可以培训一个(简单的)分类器或回归模型。 然而,与其受训的原始地球观测数据相反,嵌入表示的语义意义是事先未知的。
换句话说,我们得到了广泛的数据来源,我们知道,这些数据应当包含丰富的信息,但却被观察员所隐藏。

blocks.en: We argue that this scientific challenge – interpreting what geospatial embedding features represent – is commonly encountered in neuroscience, where recordings of neural activity are analysed to assign meaning to individual neurons or groups of neurons ( Hubel and Wiesel, 1962 ; O’Keefe and Nadel, 1978 ; Rigotti et al., 2013 ; Mante et al., 2013 ) . In this paper we explore this connection, by analysing Earth observation embeddings (embedding features × \times space) in a similar fashion to neural activity (neurons × \times time). Hence, where biological neural activity extends in one dimension (time), embedding features extend in two (space; latitude × \times longitude). In this paper we explore a variety of computational neuroscience methods originally designed to interpret neural activity, either spontaneous ( i.e. , without correlates/hypotheses) or in response to stimuli (vice versa), for both individual neurons and neuron populations, and adapt these to dissect Earth embedding features.
blocks.zh: 我们指出,这一科学挑战 — — 解释地理空间嵌入特征代表什么 — — 在神经科学中是常见的,在神经科学中,对神经活性的录音进行分析,以给单个神经元或神经元群体分配意义(Hubel和Wiesel,1962年;O ' Keefe和Nadel,1978年;Rigotti等,2013年;Mante等,2013年)。 在本文中,我们通过分析地球观测嵌入物(嵌入特征×\时空)与神经活性(中微子×\时空)类似的方式来探索这种联系. 因此,当生物神经活性在一个维度(时间)延伸时,嵌入特征会由两个维度(空间;纬度×\时间)延伸. 在本文中,我们探索了各种计算神经科学方法,这些方法最初是为了解释神经活性,或者是自发的(即没有关联/歇斯底里),或者是针对刺激的(反之亦然),既针对单个神经元和神经元种群,并对这些方法进行调整以适应分解出地球嵌入特征.

blocks.en: 2 Methods
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en:
A proof-of-principle dataset was constructed by randomly subsampling 100 locations from the S2BMS dataset (that contains over 1300 locations of butterfly habitats in the UK, thus representing a wide variety of UK landscapes) ( Van der Plas et al., 2025 ) , subsampled such that each pair of locations is at least 30 km apart.
For each location coordinate, we downloaded 128 x 128 pixel (= 1.28 km x 1.28 km) patches of 2024 AlphaEarth embeddings ( Brown et al., 2025 ) , 2024 DynamicWorld land cover (averaged across all 2024 data points, yielding a number between 0 and 1 for each land cover class) ( Brown et al., 2022 ) and Copernicus 30m DSM elevation ( ESA, 2019 ) data using Google Earth Engine ( Gorelick et al., 2017 ) . Additionally, Sentinel-2 RGB satellite images were downloaded for visualisation purposes only. We define the set of 9 DynamicWorld land cover classes and the DSM elevation layer as the set of 10 hypotheses to correlate embedding features with.
blocks.zh:
通过对S2BMS数据集的100个位置(包含联合王国1300多个位置的蝴蝶栖息地,从而代表了各种各样的联合王国地貌)进行随机分样取样,构建了一套原则性数据集(Van der Plas等人,2025年),并进行分样取样,使每一对位置相距至少30公里。
对于每个位置坐标,我们下载了128 x 128像素(= 1.28 km x 1.28 km) 2024 AlphaEarth嵌入(Brown et al., 2025), 2024 Dynamic World land covers (平均跨越所有2024个数据点,每个土地覆被类别产生的数字在0到1之间)(Brown et al., 2022)和哥白尼30m DSM高地(ESA, 2019)的补丁,使用Google Earth引擎的数据(Gorelick et al., 2017). 此外,还下载了Sentinel-2 RGB卫星图像,仅作可视化之用。 我们定义了9个动态世界土地覆被类别和DSM高地层,作为10个假设的一组,将嵌入特征联系起来。

blocks.en: The (variogram) effective range is defined as the inter-pixel distance where pixel values become statistically independent, and was calculated per feature per patch using a spherical fit, uniform bins and by sampling 4,000 pixels per patch with Scikit GStat ( Mälicke, 2022 ) . Effective range values above the patch size 1,280 m were ignored to avoid patch edge issues, which presumably would require larger patches and sample sizes to resolve (at greater computational cost).
blocks.zh: (varigram)有效范围被定义为像素值在统计学上独立化的像素间距离,每个补丁每个特征的计算使用一个球形相配,统一的"取出"并用Scikit GStat(Mälicke,2022. 已忽略了超过补丁尺寸1,280 m的有效范围值来避免补丁边缘问题,这大概需要更大的补丁和样本大小来解决(以更高的计算成本).

blocks.en:
In neuroscience, RSA is used to test whether two separate sets of measurements ( e.g. , neural and behavioural) co-vary together ( Kriegeskorte et al., 2008 ) .
Here, we used RSA to test whether effective range differences between features correlated significantly with pixel value correlations between features. We constructed a feature-to-feature negative distance matrix from the median effective ranges (negative distances were used such that higher values correspond to greater similarity) and a Pearson correlation matrix (of pixel values). These two matrices were correlated, and this value was compared against 10,000 permutations (where only the feature identity of the effective ranges were shuffled) to calculate a p p value.
blocks.zh:
在神经科学中,RSA被用于测试两套独立的测量(如神经和行为)是否共同进行(克列热斯科特等,2008年).
在这里,我们利用RSA来测试特征之间的有效范围差异是否与特征之间的像素值关联显著. 我们构建了与中位有效相距的地物到地物负相距矩阵(使用了负相距,使较高的值与更大的相近性相对应)和皮尔森相关相距矩阵(像素值)。 这两个矩阵是相互关联的,这一值被比作一万个通量(只有有效范围的特征特征被洗涤)来计算p值.

In neuroscience, tuning curves/surfaces express common stimulus properties to which neurons respond, which can be calculated using the ‘spike-triggered-average’ by temporally aligning stimulus time-series to neural ‘spike’ times ( Schwartz et al., 2006 ) .
Here, we calculated a tuning surface (TS) for each feature/hypothesis combination by spatially aligning and averaging 21 × 21 21\times 21 pixel windows of hypothesis maps, each weighted by the embedding value of the central window pixel (Fig 2 a). We fit resulting TSs with 2-dimensional Gaussians to obtain TS statistics across all features/hypotheses. TS relative strength was defined as the relative peak value of each hypothesis-TS per feature. TS ellipse shape was characterised by its peak-distance from (0, 0) and eccentricity 1 − b 2 a 2 \sqrt{1-\frac{b^{2}}{a^{2}}} where a = max ​ ( σ x , σ y ) a=\text{max}(\sigma_{x},\sigma_{y}) and b = min ​ ( σ x , σ y ) b=\text{min}(\sigma_{x},\sigma_{y}) for stds. σ x \sigma_{x} and σ y \sigma_{y} .

blocks.en: 3 Results
blocks.zh: 3 结果

blocks.en:
We use correlate-free methods to demonstrate correlational and multi-scale structure in the embeddings. We then probe the tuning of individual embedding features to land cover and elevation and find highly specific responses ( e.g. , ‘North vs South woodland edge’).
We extend this tuning analysis to groups of features, which reveal fine-grained structure after the main hypothesis trends are removed.
blocks.zh:
我们使用无关联方法,在嵌入物中显示相关和多尺度的结构。 然后,我们探索将个别嵌入特征调整为土地覆盖和高地,并找到非常具体的反应(例如 " 北对南林地边缘 " )。
我们把这种调整分析扩展到各组特征,这些特征在主要假设趋势被去除后揭示出精细的结构.

blocks.en:
Embedding features show a strong inter-feature correlation structure, leading to clusters of similarly correlated features (Fig 1 a).
We then used RSA to test whether clusters were predominantly caused by similarities in the spatial auto-correlation of embedding features. First, we calculated the effective range of each feature and constructed a matrix of distances between (median) effective ranges of all feature pairs. We then tested whether this matrix was significantly correlated to the inter-feature correlation structure, but found that is was very weakly correlated ( ρ = 0.026 \rho=0.026 , two-sided p = 0.082 p=0.082 , Fig 1 b-d). Thus, similar features may have similar scales, but there is also considerable variation of scale within clusters. Further, the PCA dimensionality increased with the number of patches (Fig 1 e), demonstrating that diversifying the dataset can decorrelate the features.
blocks.zh:
嵌入特征显示出强烈的地层间关联结构,导致类似地块相通的集群(图1 a).
然后,我们用RSA来测试集群是否主要由嵌入特征的空间自動-相通所引起. 首先,我们计算了每个特征的有效范围,并构建了所有特征对(中间)有效范围的距离矩阵。 然后,我们测试了这个矩阵是否与地缘间关联结构有显著的关联,但发现其关联性非常微弱(^ 0.026\rho=0.026,双侧p=0.082p=0.082,图1b-d). 因此,类似的特征可能具有相似的尺度,但各组内的规模也有相当大的差异。 此外,随着补丁数量(图1e)的增加,常设仲裁法院的维度也有所增加,这表明数据集的多样化可以装饰这些特征。

blocks.en: We computed tuning surfaces for all combinations of embedding features and hypotheses to determine if any features directionally encode any hypotheses (Fig 2 a). Indeed, we found a number of such examples, for example feature 47, which responds to water bodies and, specifically, distinguishes between Northern and Southern woodland edges (Fig 2 b, c). The selectivity of embedding features to specific hypotheses varied, as defined by their relative tuning strength, and furthermore we observed that off-centre peaks can be used to identify directional coding (Fig 2 b, d).
blocks.zh: 我们计算出嵌入特性和假设的所有组合的调色表面,以确定是否有任何特征定向地编码出任何假设(图2a)。 事实上,我们发现了一些这样的例子,例如第47个特征,它响应了水体,具体地说,它区分了北部和南部的林地边缘(图2b,c)。 嵌入特性对具体假设的选择性各不相同,这取决于其相对的调谐强度,此外,我们还注意到,非中心峰可用于识别方向编码(图2b,d)。

blocks.en: Finally, we asked how much variance of the embedding features is explained by the land cover and elevation hypotheses. Using OLS regression, we found that the 10 hypotheses explain on average R 2 = 0.46 R^{2}=0.46 of embedding variance. Next, because combinations of embedding features might represent combinations of hypotheses, we used canonical correlation analysis (CCA) to find the embedding reprojections that maximally correlate to the hypotheses, which explained R 2 = 0.60 R^{2}=0.60 of variance on average (Fig 3 a,b). Both residuals ( i.e. , the embeddings after subtracting the regression fits) reveal new details, as the correlations with the land cover and elevation hypotheses have effectively been removed (Fig 3 a). Accordingly, the effective dimensionality of residuals is greater than the original embedding dimensionality (Fig 3 c).
blocks.zh: 最后,我们问,土地覆盖和高地假说解释了嵌入特征的多少差异。 使用OLS回归法,我们发现10个假说平均解释R 2=0.46 R^{2}=0.46 嵌入相差. 接下来,由于嵌入特性的组合可能代表了假说组合,我们使用犬类关联分析(CCA)来寻找与假说最大关联的嵌入再预测,这解释了R 2=0.60 R^{2}=0.60的平均差异(图3 a,b). 这两种残余物(即减去回归后嵌入物)都揭示出新的细节,因为与土地覆盖和高地假说的相关性实际上已被去除(图3a)。 因此,残留物的有效维度大于原始嵌入维度(图3c)。

blocks.en: 4 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en:
We aimed to demonstrate methods new to Earth observation data analysis that can be helpful for interpreting Earth embeddings, using a small, proof-of-concept dataset of AlphaEarth embeddings.
A larger and more diverse dataset is needed to reach more definitive conclusions about AlphaEarth embedding features, and other Earth embeddings should be considered to achieve more generalised findings. It would be particularly interesting to compare Earth embeddings trained with different model architectures and loss functions, such as Presto ( Tseng et al., 2023 ) , SatCLIP ( Klemmer et al., 2025 ) and spherical harmonics ( Rußwurm et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh:
我们的目标是利用阿尔法地嵌入物的小型概念证明数据集,展示地球观测数据分析中有助于解释地嵌入物的新方法。
需要一个更大和更多样化的数据集,以便就α地嵌入特征得出更明确的结论,而其他地嵌入则应考虑以获得更概括的发现。 比较经过不同模型结构和损失功能培训的地球嵌入物将特别有意思,例如Presto(Tseng等,2023年),SatCLIP。 (克勒默等,2025年)和球形口琴(Rußwurm等,2024年).

blocks.en:
Earth embeddings are highly compressed, yet for local applications (that do not encompass the global variety of land surfaces), these embeddings might still suffer from redundancies. We show that for a diverse dataset of locations in the United Kingdom, the effective dimensionality converges to < 10 <10 , suggesting that a more efficient embedding representation may be derived for any localised application.
We further show that regressing out the projections maximally correlated to land cover and elevation increases the dimensionality of the residual embedding features, revealing new spatial variability that used to be obscured by large variance modes. Together, these findings suggest that Earth embeddings can be fine-tuned for local applications by reprojecting, selecting and assigning semantic meaning to embedding features, originally designed to describe the entire globe.
blocks.zh:
地上嵌入物高度压缩,但对于局部应用(不包括全球陆地地表的多样性),这些地上嵌入物仍可能存在冗余. 我们显示,对于联合王国各种地点的数据集,有效的维度趋同到 < 10 < 10,这表明任何本地化的应用都可以得到更有效的嵌入代表。
我们进一步显示,与土地覆盖和高地最大程度相关预测的退步增加了剩余嵌入地貌的维度,揭示出新的空间变异性,这些变异性过去被大相径庭的模式所掩盖。 这些研究结果合在一起表明,地球嵌入可以通过重新预测、选择和赋予嵌入特征的语义意义来细化当地应用,最初是为了描述整个地球。
